verses.text: Then God blessed Noah and his sons. He said to them, "Have many children and increase in number, and fill the earth.

All the animals on earth, all the birds in the sky, all the creatures that move along the ground and all the fish in the sea will be afraid of you and terrified of you. I am putting them into your hands.
Everything that lives and moves will be food for you. Just as I gave you the green plants, I now give you everything.
But you must not eat meat that still has its lifeblood in it.
And for your own lifeblood I will demand payment. I will demand it from every animal that kills a person, and I will demand it from every person who kills another person.
Whoever kills a human being will be killed by human beings, because God made human beings in his own image.
As for you, have many children and increase in number. Spread out over the earth and fill it."
Then God said to Noah and to his sons with him,
"Now I am making my covenant with you and with your children after you,
and with every living creature that was with you: the birds, the farm animals and all the wild animals, all those that came out of the ark with you, every living creature on earth.
I am making my covenant with you. Never again will all life be wiped out by the waters of a flood. Never again will there be a flood to destroy the earth."
And God said, "This is the sign of the covenant I am making between me and you and every living creature with you, for all generations to come:
I have put my rainbow in the clouds. It will be the sign of the covenant between me and the earth.
Whenever I bring clouds over the earth and the rainbow appears in the clouds,
I will remember my covenant between me and you and every kind of living creature. Never again will the waters become a flood to destroy all life.
Whenever the rainbow appears in the clouds, I will see it and remember the covenant that will last for ever between God and every kind of living creature on the earth."
So God said to Noah, "This is the sign of the covenant I have made between me and all life on the earth."
The sons of Noah who came out of the ark were Shem, Ham and Japheth. Ham was the father of Canaan.
These three were the sons of Noah, and from them came all the people who spread out over the whole earth.
Noah was a farmer, and he was the first to plant a vineyard.
He drank some of its wine and became drunk, and he lay naked inside his tent.
Ham, the father of Canaan, saw his father naked, and he went outside and told his two brothers.

But Shem and Japheth took a cloak and laid it across their shoulders. Then they walked in backwards and covered their father's naked body. They kept their faces turned away so that they would not see their father naked.
When Noah woke up from his drunkenness, he found out what his youngest son had done to him.
He said, "May Canaan be cursed! He will be the lowest of slaves to his brothers."
He also said, "Praise the LORD, the God of Shem! May Canaan be Shem's slave.
May God give Japheth more land. May Japheth live in the tents of Shem, and may Canaan be his slave."
After the flood Noah lived three hundred and fifty years.
Noah lived nine hundred and fifty years in all, and then he died.
